notes.title: Patch 0.4.4
notes.content:
[p][b]Hi! ElJoka here![/b]
Here’s what we achieved with this patch:[/p][p]As some of you know, a few days ago I changed the system so you no longer need to keep the game open for the timer to run!
You can now close the game and wait out the 2-hour cooldown. Once you log back in, I recommend waiting about 1 minute before fishing.[/p][p]The in-game timer display wasn’t matching real time, so here’s what I fixed:[/p][list][*][p][b]Timer UI[/b] now matches real-world time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Info tab[/b] updated to clearly state you don’t need the game open for the timer.[/p][/*][/list][p]I also fixed a couple of achievements so they work as intended:[/p][list][*][p][b]Achievement “Fast Reeler”[/b] now correctly triggers only when you catch a fish within the first 0.1 seconds of the catch window.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievement “Never Too Late”[/b] now correctly triggers only when you catch a fish within the last 0.1 seconds of the catch window.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I also wanted to give you a sneak peek at some [b]new fish[/b]! 🐟
Here are 3 of the fish that will be available during the Halloween event. As you can see, [b]event-exclusive fish will feature a special gem[/b] indicating which event they came from — for Halloween, I’ve chosen [b]orange[/b].[/p][p]The event will include around [b]20–30 brand-new fish[/b] that will only be available during its ~2-week run. I’ll share all the spooky details soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619732/864870de781ffb735378f7687e7aa2bc0279ea39.png"][/img][/p]
